author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override λ0.605 kd22 k=55 δ0.10 emb_k=17 γ_max=0.70 (DAQB)
abstract: Same k=55 densification probe but with δ=0.10 to test sensitivity of DAQB edge selection under slightly lower local-scale exponent; evaluate trade‑offs in ARI/NMI vs kBET/Graph_conn while keeping PCR≈1.0.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=55,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
